12.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
12.text: "We currently have more than 20 operational groups in total, including our naval forces."

19.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
19.text: "We currently have more than 15 operational groups in total, including our navy."

20.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
20.text: "We currently have less than 15 operational groups in total, including our navy."

21.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
21.text: "We currently have less than 10 operational groups in total, including our navy."

31.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
31.text: "This operation has cost us many lives. Around 20 divisions have perished on the battlefield."

32.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
32.text: "This operation has cost us more lives than expected. Around 15 divisions have perished on the battlefield."

33.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
33.text: "Meanwhile, around 10 divisions have perished on the battlefield."

34.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
34.text: "Thankfully, we had minimal casualties on the battlefield."

42.speaker: Narrator
42.text: He handed me a stack of papers detailing the operation results.

54.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
54.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn08_OperationResult_Numbers"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn08_OperationResult_Objectives"] == true  or Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn08_OperationResult_Resistance"] == true  or Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn08_OperationResult_WarSupport"] == false

55.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
55.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn08_OperationResult_Numbers"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn08_OperationResult_Objectives"] == true  or Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn08_OperationResult_Resistance"] == true  or Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn08_OperationResult_WarSupport"] == false) == false

56.speaker: Player_Romus
56.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn08_OperationResult_Numbers"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn08_OperationResult_Objectives"] == true  or Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn08_OperationResult_Resistance"] == true  or Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn08_OperationResult_WarSupport"] == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Pales_Operation1_Won"] == true)

57.speaker: Player_Romus
57.text: "Tell me about our numbers. How many troops do we have? How many have we lost?"

59.speaker: Player_Romus
59.text: "Are we seeing a lot of resistance from the civilian population?"

60.speaker: Player_Romus
60.text: "Tell me about public opinion back home. What do Rizians think about the war?"

61.speaker: Lucita Azaro
61.text: "Our intelligence reports indicate that the enemy has taken mass casualties."

71.speaker: Lucita Azaro
71.text: "Our intelligence reports indicate that the enemy has taken many casualties."

72.speaker: Lucita Azaro
72.text: "Our intelligence reports indicate that the enemy has taken quite a few casualties."

73.speaker: Lucita Azaro
73.text: "The latest numbers state that we have successfully destroyed more than 20 divisions."

74.speaker: Lucita Azaro
74.text: "Our intelligence reports indicate that the enemy has not taken many casualties."

75.speaker: Lucita Azaro
75.text: "The latest numbers state that we have successfully destroyed more than 15 divisions."

76.speaker: Lucita Azaro
76.text: "The latest numbers state that we have successfully destroyed more than 10 divisions."

77.speaker: Lucita Azaro
77.text: "The latest numbers state that we have successfully destroyed less than 10 divisions."

78.speaker: Lucita Azaro
78.text: "Unfortunately, the Palesians are tougher than we expected."

79.speaker: Lucita Azaro
79.text: "They are tough, but so are we."

80.speaker: Lucita Azaro
80.text: "Honestly, even I didn't think it would be this easy."

81.speaker: Lucita Azaro
81.text: "They're dropping like flies, Your Majesty. Left and right."

89.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
89.text: "We have taken Arces and Ziqes. New forward operating bases have been set up nearby."

93.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
93.text: "We have taken Arces. New forward operating bases have been set up nearby."
93.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Objective_Captured_Arces"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Objective_Captured_Arces"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Objective_Captured_Ziqes"] == true) == false)

97.speaker: Player_Romus
97.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn08_OperationResult_Numbers"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn08_OperationResult_Objectives"] == true  or Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn08_OperationResult_Resistance"] == true  or Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn08_OperationResult_WarSupport"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Pales_Operation1_Won"] == true) == false)

98.speaker: Player_Romus
98.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn08_OperationResult_Numbers"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn08_OperationResult_Objectives"] == true  or Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn08_OperationResult_Resistance"] == true  or Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn08_OperationResult_WarSupport"] == false

99.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
99.text: "We have taken Ziqes. New forward operating bases have been set up nearby."
99.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Objective_Captured_Arces"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Objective_Captured_Ziqes"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Objective_Captured_Arces"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Objective_Captured_Ziqes"] == true) == false)

100.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
100.text: "Regretfully, we have yet to capture any of our main operation objectives."

110.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
110.text: "With great sadness, I must also inform you that we have lost control of Terador and Fort Ales."

111.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
111.text: "With great sadness, I must also inform you that we have lost control of Fort Ales."
111.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Objective_Captured_Terador"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Objective_Captured_FortAles"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Objective_Captured_FortAles"] == false)

112.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
112.text: "With great sadness, I must also inform you that we have lost control of Terador."
112.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Objective_Captured_Terador"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Objective_Captured_FortAles"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Objective_Captured_FortAles"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Objective_Captured_Terador"] == false)

113.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
113.text: "Despite the heavy fighting, Fort Ales and Terador are still under our control."
113.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Objective_Captured_Terador"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Objective_Captured_FortAles"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Objective_Captured_FortAles"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Objective_Captured_Terador"] == false) == false)

114.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
114.text: "A minor setback. I'm confident we'll regain the ground we lost."

123.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
123.text: "A sizeable resistance is growing, Your Majesty."

124.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
124.text: "Yes, sire. But all within our expectations."

125.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
125.text: "There doesn't seem to be much of it. It's as I suspected -- Pales *wants* to rejoin Rizia."

126.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
126.text: "Or we've simply intimidated civilians into submission. Either way, this works in our favor."

127.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
127.text: "We're doing everything we can to keep it contained."

133.speaker: Lucita Azaro
133.text: "The people are on our side, Your Majesty."

134.speaker: Lucita Azaro
134.text: "General sentiment seems to be against the war, Your Majesty."

135.speaker: Lucita Azaro
135.text: "But once we have a big win, I think the tide will change."

136.speaker: Lucita Azaro
136.text: "And the more we keep winning, the more their sympathies will increase."

137.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
137.text: "Their strength keeps us strong. We will not lose."

139.speaker: Narrator
139.text: The room fell silent. Lucita spoke after a few long seconds.

140.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
140.text: "If you please, Your Majesty, we need more manpower and equipment."

144.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
144.text: "This might be the only way we can regain our footing."

145.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
145.text: "We've achieved promising results, but we are not done yet."

149.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
149.text: "Precisely. Our manpower is dwindling. New recruits would provide valuable support."

150.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
150.text: "Precisely. Additional recruits would provide valuable support."

154.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
154.text: And of course, these troops will require more ammunition and weapons. Our operation has nearly depleted our supply."

155.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
155.text: "And of course, these troops will require ammo and weapons. We still have a decent stockpile, but more won't hurt."

156.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
156.text: "Your Majesty, one thing is certain. We can't win this war without able and capable boots on the ground."

157.speaker: Player_Romus
157.text: "I will do whatever I can to support the army."

158.speaker: Player_Romus
158.text: "I hear you two. You do your part and I will do mine."

159.speaker: Player_Romus
159.text: "We also can't win this war without able and capable generals."

161.speaker: Lucita Azaro
161.text: "The result of Golden Shield is clear, Your Majesty. We are on the right path."

166.speaker: Lucita Azaro
166.text: "As these documents outline, the operation has been a great success."

167.speaker: Lucita Azaro
167.text: "Before we discuss the next steps, we need your seal on the results."

168.speaker: Narrator
168.text: General Azaro handed me a large scroll and a candle for the wax. I opened it.

169.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
169.text: Press the seal on the wax.

171.speaker: Player_Romus
171.text: "You have done well. I am proud of all of you. Not only for your exemplary service, but on a personal level."

172.speaker: Player_Romus
172.text: "Thank *you* for your service to the crown."

174.speaker: Player_Romus
174.text: "I will not allow any failures. Do you understand?"

181.speaker: Lucita Azaro
181.text: "The result of Golden Shield is unfortunately clear, Your Majesty."

185.speaker: Narrator
185.text: The old general descended from his wheelchair and knelt before me, pressing his forehead into the ground.

186.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
186.text: "My liege. My King. My lord. I have failed you."

187.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
187.text: "Do what you will with me. I leave my life at your mercy."

188.speaker: Player_Romus
188.text: "Get up, General. A man of your stature should not humiliate himself like this."

189.speaker: Player_Romus
189.text: "If you think this will convince me to spare you, you are wrong."

190.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
190.text: "This war should have been ours to win. I deserve punishment."

191.speaker: Player_Romus
191.text: "My mercy? What kind of king do you think I am?"

192.speaker: Player_Romus
192.text: "Fix your mess, General. That is all I care about."

193.speaker: Narrator
193.text: He wouldn't budge. Lucita rolled her eyes in frustration.

194.speaker: Lucita Azaro
194.text: "Father. Stop your hysterics and allow me to help you back into your chair."

198.speaker: Player_Romus
198.text: "You will receive no punishment. You will continue working for the Crown. That is all."

200.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
200.text: "You are too kind to me, Your Majesty. But I shall accept and respect your decision."

201.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
201.text: "I accept and respect your punishment, Your Majesty."

202.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
202.text: "I will redeem myself to you. This I promise in the name of House Azaro."

203.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
203.text: "So this is my punishment. I have disgraced myself, my family and my kingdom."

205.speaker: Player_Romus
205.text: "I am bored of this charade. I don't have all day. Keep going with your briefing."

206.speaker: Player_Romus
206.text: "Do not be so harsh on yourself, General. It's bad for morale."

209.speaker: Lucita Azaro
209.text: "Now. It's time for us to talk about our next steps."

210.speaker: Narrator
210.text: Lucita helped him back into his chair.

211.speaker: Lucita Azaro
211.text: "Rom-- Your Majesty! What have you just done?"

216.speaker: Lucita Azaro
216.text: "Your Majesty! What have you just done?"

217.speaker: Lucita Azaro
217.text: "Berate me for my failures if you wish. But to disgrace the highest-ranking member of House Azaro?"

218.speaker: Player_Romus
218.text: "You can and you will. Do not question my authority."

219.speaker: Lucita Azaro
219.text: "I cannot just sit idly by and take this."

220.speaker: Player_Romus
220.text: "Then make General Taddeus earn his rank. All I see is failure upon failure."

222.speaker: Player_Romus
222.text: "I'm sorry. You are right. I made a rash decision."

223.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
223.text: "Please, sire. She did not mean it that way."

224.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
224.text: "Lucita. Apologize to your King this second."

225.speaker: Lucita Azaro
225.text: "That problem is mine to handle. I don't need your intervention."

226.speaker: Lucita Azaro
226.text: "God. How could you do this to an old man? In a wheelchair?"

227.speaker: Lucita Azaro
227.text: "You insulted my father. How am I supposed to react?"

229.speaker: Narrator
229.text: She collected herself and spoke through gritted teeth.

233.speaker: Lucita Azaro
233.text: "I will do what I must to make sure we win this war. Leave my father out of it."

241.speaker: Player_Romus
241.text: "Don't forget that both of you are responsible for this failure."

242.speaker: Lucita Azaro
242.text: "Can we please just move on, Your Majesty?"

250.speaker: Narrator
250.text: Lucita drew a breath in through her teeth.
250.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Objective_Captured_Arces"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Objective_Captured_Ziqes"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Objective_Captured_Arces"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Objective_Captured_Ziqes"] == true) == false)

256.speaker: Narrator
256.text: She clutched her forehead and took a deep breath, forcing herself to calm down. Taddeus kept his eyes on the ground.

257.speaker: Lucita Azaro
257.text: "Our troops can still win this, Your Majesty. Just give us a chance."

261.speaker: Narrator
261.text: The old general descended from his wheelchair and knelt before me, pressing his forehead to the floor.

263.speaker: Narrator
263.text: Before I could say anything, Taddeus turned to Carlos.

264.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
264.text: "Would you excuse us for a moment, General?"

265.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
265.text: "If that is your wish, then certainly."

266.speaker: Narrator
266.text: He bowed to me and then to Taddeus before stepping out of the tent, confused. Taddeus tapped on his daughter's arm.

269.speaker: Narrator
269.text: Carlos was brought back into the room.

270.speaker: Narrator
270.text: His expression was one of surprise as he glanced between Taddeus and Lucita, as if trying to decipher what had just taken place.

275.speaker: Narrator
275.text: His eyes quickly took in the sight of Taddeus, noting that his medals had been stripped from his jacket -- a clear sign that something had just transpired.

276.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
276.text: "House Sazon’s troops are still in perfect shape and ready to continue the fight."

280.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
280.text: "House Sazon held their ground and made steady gains, though enemy resistance made progress difficult."

284.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
284.text: "House Sazon’s forces were completely overrun -- the survivors are either captured or dead."

285.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
285.text: "House Toras didn't suffer any losses, showcasing their efficiency and skill."

289.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
289.text: "House Toras held the line with fierce determination, though advancing proved difficult."

293.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
293.text: "House Toras was annihilated. There are no reports of survivors from their last position."

294.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
294.text: "House Azaro’s forces showed remarkable coordination, emerging unscathed so far."

298.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
298.text: "House Azaro inflicted significant damage, but the enemy still holds strategic ground."

302.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
302.text: "House Azaro’s warriors are no more, but they perished as true sons of Rizia -- undaunted, outnumbered, and defiant to their last breath."

306.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll

309.speaker: Narrator
309.text: Carlos gave him a questionable look.
